import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { Router } from '@angular/router'; import { NfcData } from '../../../core/models/nfc-data.model'; @Component({ selector: 'app-vehicule-nfc', templateUrl: './vehicule-nfc.page.html' }) export class VehiculeNfcPage implements OnInit { nfcData: NfcData | null = null; status: 'idle' | 'writing' | 'success' | 'error' = 'idle'; errorMsg = ''; constructor(private router: Router) {} ngOnInit(): void { const state = history.state; this.nfcData = state?.nfcData ?? null; if (!this.nfcData) this.router.navigate(['/vehicules']); } async startWrite(): Promise { if (!this.nfcData) return; if (!('NDEFReader' in window)) { this.status = 'error'; this.errorMsg = 'NFC non disponible sur cet appareil.'; return; } this.status = 'writing'; try { const ndef = new (window as any).NDEFReader(); await ndef.write({ records: [{ recordType: 'text', data: this.nfcData.record1 }] }); this.status = 'success'; } catch (err: any) { this.status = 'error'; this.errorMsg = err?.message ?? 'Erreur lors de l\'écriture NFC.'; } } goBack(): void { this.router.navigate(['/vehicules']); } }
